title: The Skyline Process: Quantifying Sky Visibility in 3D Urban Environments
summary: Non-terrestrial networks (NTNs) are considered a promising technology for seamless, universal communication in the 6G era. However, signals from NTN elements to ground users are often blocked by high-rise buildings in dense urban environments. To quantify this blocking effect, in this paper, we propose a novel analytical framework by modeling the location of buildings as a 3D skyline process based on stochastic geometry and we derive closed-form expressions for the distribution of the blockage elevation angles.
